before_provenance: Reuses the ten after-small and after-large observations in monitor-2026-10-08-sidebar.json from committed stage db89158; identical release executable and profiler/fixtures.
limitations: Fresh synthetic homes, warm filesystem caches, serialized launches. Before and after are separate workstation intervals; other desktop apps remain running. No builds/full tests or automation overlap after observations. Readiness is first populated sidebar state publication, not displayed pixels or all history. Sampled RSS is a lower-bound peak. Ten launch tails are descriptive, not stable p95 estimates. Stage events are pooled across ten launches. Transport counts exclude discovery, shell and setup processes; fixed observation windows may complete different numbers of polls.

cold_stack_probe.limitations: Separate fresh-catalog launch; profiler observe helper forced sample=True on its first launch. Stack sampling perturbs execution; no frame/stall latency distribution is inferred. Local stack text contains device metadata and is not published.
